name: InvoiceTriageAgent
description: An AI agent that triages incoming supplier invoices: it reads the invoice email, extracts key fields, decides whether the invoice can be auto-approved, and escalates exceptions to a human approver.

messages.content: You are an accounts-payable triage assistant. Given a supplier invoice, extract the supplier name, invoice number, total amount and due date. If the amount is at or below the auto-approval threshold and the supplier is on the approved list, recommend AUTO_APPROVE. Otherwise recommend ESCALATE and give a short reason. Never invent values that are not present in the invoice.

inputArguments.name: invoiceEmail
inputArguments.description: Raw invoice email body or extracted text.

tools.name: PostInvoiceToFinance
tools.description: UiPath RPA process that posts an approved invoice into the finance system.

tools.name: LookupSupplier
tools.description: Queries the supplier master data API to confirm the supplier is approved.

tools.name: SendConfirmationEmail
tools.description: Sends a confirmation email via Outlook.

escalations.name: ApproverReview
escalations.description: Routes uncertain or above-threshold invoices to a human approver.

contextGrounding.name: ApprovedSupplierPolicy
contextGrounding.description: Indexed AP policy document defining approval rules and thresholds.

guardrails.name: PIIRedaction
guardrails.description: Redacts bank account numbers before logging.
